messages:
Sarah L.: Heads-up — planning to cut release/1.13 tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need someone to spin up the branch and volunteers for backports + changelog bundling. Who can take the branch creation and who will own backports/changelog?

TJ: I can create the branch. What's the exact tag we should branch from?

Sarah L.: Base off tag `v1.13.0-rc2` (sha abc1234). Use `release/1.13` as the branch name. Example commands:```
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.13 v1.13.0-rc2
git push origin release/1.13
```

Mike R.: I can take the changelog bundle. @Anita P., can you own backports? I'll collect PRs that should be included. Suggest we mark eligible PRs with label `backport/1.13`.

Anita P.: I can own backports. Quick policy check: only critical bugfixes, regressions, and perf fixes after rc2? No features unless explicitly approved by PM and Eng leads.

Sarah L.: Correct — bugfix/regression/perf only. No feature flips. For backports, create cherry-pick commits and push them to `release/1.13`. Example:```
git checkout release/1.13
git cherry-pick -x <commit-sha>
# resolve conflicts, commit, then:
git push origin HEAD:release/1.13
```

Kai W.: Heads-up: PR #3421 (perf op rewrite) is still flaky in staging. Strongly recommend excluding unless we have green perf bench + e2e. @Anita P. marking it as risky.

Anita P.: Noted — will exclude #3421 from the backport queue unless we get green across bench + e2e. I'll flag risky items in the tracking doc.

TJ: Branch created and pushed: `release/1.13` (sha abc1234). Created protection rule and opened the branch PR to add required checks. CI kicked off.

release-bot: branch release/1.13 created by TJ at abc1234. Protection: required status checks (ci/unit, ci/integration, codeowners).

Sarah L.: Thanks TJ & team. Reminder: cutoff is 02:00 UTC tomorrow — after that only emergency fixes (must be flagged and approved by eng lead).

Mike R.: Draft changelog PR up: https://github.com/redwood/inference/compare/release/1.13... I'll populate change sections and call out authors. Ping here for copy edits.

TJ: Quick backport tip: use GH CLI to create a branch and PR:```
gh pr create --base release/1.13 --head me:backport-3421 --title "backport: fix X (3421)" --label backport/1.13
``` Also add reviewers `@Anita P.`, `@Sarah L.`

Anita P.: I'll triage the backport queue tonight and start landing low-risk fixes. If I hit conflicts, I'll post the conflict diff here for help. If anything looks borderline, I'll request a staging run Thursday.

Sarah L.: :thumbsup: Keep updates in this thread. If someone hits a stubborn conflict, paste the `git diff` + short note and I'll jump in. Let's aim to have changelog ready by EOD today so release notes copy review can happen during the cutoff window.
